subject: nothing loads since this morning
body: Since about 8am every page shows a connection error. I've tried my laptop, my phone, office wifi and mobile data. Two colleagues say the same thing. Is something down?
notes: Scope is the signal: multiple devices, multiple networks, multiple people. Total failure, so outage rather than software_bug, and P1 by the service-down rule.

subject: app closes when I open settings
body: Every time I tap the settings gear the app closes instantly. Everything else works fine, I can sync and browse files normally. Android 14, app version 4.2.1.
notes: One action broken, rest works. The scope test separates this from outage. Workaround exists (avoid settings) so P3.

subject: sync takes three hours now
body: My library still syncs, it just takes about three hours where it used to be ten minutes. Nothing failed, it's just crawling. About 40k files.
notes: The user explicitly says it completes. Speed, not correctness, so performance not software_bug. This is the boundary the prompt names.

subject: laptop wont power on
body: My laptop won't turn on at all. No charging light, tried two cables and three different sockets. Nothing on screen. Bought it 8 months ago so it should still be under warranty.
notes: Physical device, user already ruled out cable and socket. Warranty mentioned so an RMA path is likely. Core function dead with no workaround, so P2.

subject: lost my authenticator phone
body: I lost the phone that had my authenticator app. I know my email and password but I can't get past the second factor. How do I get back in?
notes: Identity recovery. A person must own this: no draft should ever explain how to bypass a second factor.

subject: do you have a linux client
body: Is there a native Linux desktop client, or planned? I run Ubuntu and the web version is all I can use right now.
notes: Asks for a capability that does not exist. Honest answer is whether it exists and that it is logged. Safe to auto-answer.

subject: how do I move to a new laptop
body: I just got a new machine. What's the right way to move my account and files across without re-downloading everything?
notes: Operating a feature that works as designed. Well covered, low risk.

subject: sab kuch band ho gaya hai
body: aaj subah se kuch bhi load nahi ho raha. laptop pe bhi phone pe bhi same error aa raha hai. office ke sab log bol rahe hain same problem hai. kab thik hoga?
notes: Hinglish outage with the same scope markers as t001. Tests that language detection does not disturb intent.

subject: laptop charge nahi ho raha
body: kal se laptop charge nahi ho raha hai. cable badal ke dekha, dusre socket mein bhi try kiya, koi light nahi aa rahi. warranty mein hai abhi.
notes: Hinglish counterpart of t004.

subject: password reset email never arrives
body: I've requested a password reset four times over two days and nothing arrives. Checked spam. The address is definitely right, I get your billing emails on it.
notes: Locked out with no workaround. The user has already ruled out the obvious cause, which a good draft must not repeat back at them.

subject: exported file is empty
body: I export a folder to zip, it says export complete, and the zip is 0 bytes. Happens every time on the desktop app. The files are definitely there.
notes: Reproducible, produces wrong output, and silent success makes it worse than a visible error. No workaround, so P2.

subject: screen has vertical lines after I dropped it
body: Dropped my tablet yesterday and now there are coloured vertical lines down the left third of the screen. Touch still works. Is this repairable?
notes: Physical damage, user-caused, so warranty likely does not apply. A draft that promises free repair would be wrong.

subject: app uses 8gb of ram
body: After a few hours the desktop app is sitting at 8GB of memory and my machine starts swapping. Restarting it fixes it for a while. 16GB machine, macOS.
notes: A memory leak is a performance problem by the speed test: it works, it degrades. Restart is a workaround, so P3.

subject: sso just loops
body: Clicking sign in with SSO bounces me to our identity provider and straight back to the login page. Over and over. Other apps with the same SSO work fine.
notes: Cannot sign in, but only for this user, so account_access not outage. The prompt names this exact boundary.

subject: can I get a refund on the annual plan
body: I upgraded to annual last week and I don't think we'll use it. Can I get money back, or switch to monthly?
notes: The tech taxonomy has no billing intent, so this must land in other. A ticket the desk is not shaped for is worth measuring.

subject: possible vulnerability in your file sharing
body: I think public share links may be enumerable. I'd rather not put the details in a support ticket. Who do I send this to?
notes: Security report. The urgency rule sends any security concern to P1 regardless of intent, and no automated reply should engage with the detail.

subject: notifications come through four times
body: Every notification arrives three or four times. Same event, same second. Only on the phone app, desktop is fine.
notes: Annoying but nothing is blocked, so P4 despite being a clear defect.

subject: dark mode resets every restart
body: I set dark mode, close the app, open it again and it's back to light. Every time. Windows 11.
notes: Setting not persisting is a defect, cosmetic impact only.

subject: how do I stop it syncing on mobile data
body: I keep blowing through my data allowance. Is there a way to make it only sync on wifi?
notes: A setting that exists. Straightforward and well covered.

subject: docking station drops my monitors
body: The dock randomly stops detecting both external monitors. Unplugging and replugging brings them back for an hour or so. Started after I got the new dock.
notes: Peripheral hardware, intermittent, workaround exists. Tests that intermittent physical faults are not read as software_bug.

subject: update ke baad app slow ho gaya
body: pichle update ke baad app bahut slow ho gaya hai. khulta hai but 2-3 minute lagta hai start hone mein. pehle instant tha.
notes: Hinglish performance case. The user blames the update; the classifier should still classify the evidence, which is slowness.

subject: seat still shows as used
body: A developer left three weeks ago and their licence seat still shows as occupied. I can't assign it to the new hire. Admin panel won't let me revoke it.
notes: Licence seats are account_access in this taxonomy. Blocked but not urgent, and touching another person's account needs a human.

subject: thanks
body: Just wanted to say Priya on your support team sorted my sync problem in ten minutes yesterday. Great service.
notes: Praise. Safe to answer automatically and a useful check that positive sentiment is detected.

subject: it doesnt work
body: nothing works pls fix
notes: Deliberately unclassifiable. 'Nothing works' reads like outage but no product, device or symptom is named, so a confident outage call here is overconfidence. Confidence should be low.
